layers.role: Scene input normalization and provenance capture.
layers.output_class: canonical artifacts or task evidence depending on run context
provenance_requirements: do not substitute external GT map sources

layers.role: Rich-semantic, light-geometry indoor world model generation.
layers.output_class: canonical artifacts when promoted; candidate artifacts during staged reruns
provenance_requirements: do not call this the Stage-A Layer

layers.role: Export formal artifacts for routing, connector interfaces, object interfaces, and stable occupancy map generation.
layers.output_class: canonical artifacts after promotion; task evidence before promotion
provenance_requirements: keep staged artifacts separate from clean_rerun until promoted

layers.role: Prepare downstream routing and execution interfaces by consuming formal artifacts, including stable occupancy maps.
layers.output_class: canonical interface artifacts or task evidence
provenance_requirements: do not use simulator navmesh as source

layers.role: Validate or demonstrate downstream interfaces and runtime behavior.
provenance_requirements: do not promote runtime evidence into committed_public
do not claim unvalidated robot capabilities

map_distinctions.stable_occupancy_map: Floor-wise navigation raster generated in Layer 2 from World Model Layer BEV/free-space/wall/outside-boundary/gateway evidence and consumed in Layer 3 for A*, map_server, lightweight executor, and navigation validation. It is not an external map, semantic floorplan, room mask, or runtime costmap.
map_distinctions.local_global_costmap: Runtime internal state, not an RSLG-SLAM world model artifact.
